item.title: Mini Crackme: x86-64 (Windows)
item.description:
Target: Windows x64, single argument passed in ecx. Find the decimal value (0-255) passed in ecx that makes check return 1.
check: mov eax, ecx shr eax, 4 and eax, 0Fh cmp eax, 5 jne fail mov eax, ecx and eax, 0Fh cmp eax, 0Ah jne fail mov eax, 1 ret fail: mov eax, 0 ret
Answer: 90 (0x5A)
1. The first block shifts the input right 4 bits and masks with 0Fh, isolating the high nibble -- it must equal 5. 2. The second block masks the original value with 0Fh directly, isolating the low nibble -- it must equal 0xA. 3. The only byte satisfying both nibble constraints is 0x5A, which is 90 in decimal.
